text:
Lina (Security): Heads up — we've flagged several production container images that were built without verified signatures and use older, unpatched base layers. We need a fast, company-wide rollout of an image-signing + CI verification policy. Action items below.

raj (SRE): How urgent? Any active exploit or just posture?

Lina (Security): Not an active exploit in our infra yet, but a recent supply-chain bulletin (newer followups on CVE-2026-2145 chain) increases risk for unsigned images. We want to prevent supply-chain tampering and make rollbacks safer. Marking HIGH priority for services exposed to external traffic.

amanda (Infra): What exactly are we requiring? cosign? sigstore?

Lina (Security): Yes — standardize on cosign (Sigstore). Policy summary: 1) All new images must be signed at build time. 2) CI must verify signatures before pushing to prod registries. 3) Existing production images older than 30 days must be rebuilt & signed within 7 days. 4) Failure to verify should block deploys to prod.

sid (Search): For the search service: rebuild + retag + redeploy will require a short maintenance window. Is there an approved key to sign with?

Lina (Security): Use the org KMS key we published in the security handbook: k8s://projects/redwood-keys/cosign-root. If you need access, request via the internal IAM flow (policy: image-signing-admin). We'll rotate signing keys per quarter.

amanda (Infra): I'll drop a CI template PR with a new step. Example snippet for GitHub Actions:

```
- name: Verify image signature
  run: |
    IMAGE=$GCR_IMAGE
    cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood-keys/cosign-root $IMAGE
```

Please include fallback for ephemeral dev branches (we'll allow unsigned for feature/* with a flag).

infra-bot: Created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/ci-templates/pull/142 adding cosign verify step to the deploy workflow.

raj (SRE): For canary deploy paths we should add a soft-fail with alerting for the first 48h so we don't bricking canaries if something misconfigures. Then strict-block after that window.

Lina (Security): Agreed. Plan: 48h soft enforcement + alert -> 7d strict enforcement. We'll run audits and send owner lists.

sid (Search): Where will owners see the list of impacted images?

security-bot: Audit run queued. Generating list of unsigned images older than 30 days. Report will be posted in #eng-security/imd-report-177800. Expected ETA 2h.

Lina (Security): Owners: expect DMs with a prioritized list; please ack within 4 hours of receiving. If you cannot rebuild in time, ping @amanda for temporary allowlist and remediation plan.

amanda (Infra): Deployment impact: infra will ship a release to include the verify step into the global deploy workflow tonight at 23:00 UTC. If you need an exception, open an ops-ticket and tag @amanda.

sid (Search): Ack — scheduling a rebuild tomorrow morning and will sign images.

raj (SRE): We'll add a Prometheus metric for signature verification failures and a PagerDuty rule for >5 failed deploys in 15m.

Lina (Security): Timeline recap: initial audit now -> infra CI template PR merged (tonight) -> owners get lists (2h) -> 48h soft-enforce -> 7d strict block for images >30d.

amanda (Infra): FYI — we added a helper script for builders:

```
#!/bin/bash
IMAGE=$1
cosign sign --key k8s://projects/redwood-keys/cosign-root $IMAGE
```

Drop into /infra/tools/cosign-sign.sh. Use responsibly.

raj (SRE): Noted. I'll coordinate maintenance windows with teams that have heavy stateful workloads.

Lina (Security): Thanks all. Please ack this thread once you've either (a) rebuilt and signed, (b) opened an exception ticket, or (c) scheduled work. We'll follow up with a full incident-style post if any unsigned image is detected in prod after the 7-day window. :lock:

sid (Search): Ack — rebuilt and signed. Pushing tags now.

infra-bot: ci-templates PR merged (142) by amanda.

deploy-bot: Global deploy workflow updated to include cosign verification.

Lina (Security): Closing loop — security audit shows 85% compliance after first pass. Teams with outstanding items received DMs. Thanks for the quick turn-around. If you hit any blocker, DM me or file an ops-ticket. :thumbsup:
